docs: Unix timestamp (seconds) of the last invest. 0 means never invested.

fields.name: refTickIndexPrice
docs: A tick index (Meteora: bin id), not a price: the snapshot written by
set_ref_tick_index_price. Invest converts it to the pool price it encodes and uses
that price as the reference the current pool price must stay close to.

fields.name: refTickIndexPriceTimestamp
docs: Unix timestamp (seconds) of the last ref_tick_index_price snapshot. 0 means never set.

fields.name: investCooldownSeconds
docs: Minimum seconds between invests per strategy. 0 disables the cooldown.

fields.name: unfreezeAuthority
docs: Counterpart of `emergency_council`: may only unset emergency/block flags (never set
them). Expected to be a multisig with a lower signature threshold than the admin
multisig, for faster recovery.

fields.name: maxInvestBpsPerOperation
docs: Optional per-invest BPS cap over total strategy value. 0 means unset.

fields.name: maxInvestUsdPerOperation
docs: Optional per-invest USD cap, using USD_DECIMALS_PRECISION decimals. 0 means unset.

fields.name: refPriceMaxTtlSeconds
docs: Seconds TTL for the stored strategy ref_tick_index_price snapshot. 0 disables invest-time
snapshot checks so existing strategies keep their current behavior.

fields.name: minRefPriceAgeSeconds
docs: Minimum age in seconds for the stored strategy ref_tick_index_price snapshot on invest.
0 disables the check. The setter caps the value at 60 seconds and enforces min age <=
ref_price_max_ttl_seconds / 2 while that TTL is nonzero. A TTL of 0 disables all snapshot
checks, so a nonzero min age retained from before the TTL was zeroed is ignored.

fields.name: mintAuthority
docs: Optional authority used to mint new tokens. The mint authority may only
be provided during mint creation. If no mint authority is present
then the mint has a fixed supply and no further tokens may be minted.

fields.name: supply
docs: Total supply of tokens.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Number of base 10 digits to the right of the decimal place.

fields.name: isInitialized
docs: Is `true` if this structure has been initialized.

fields.name: freezeAuthority
docs: Optional authority to freeze token accounts.

instructions.name: flashSwapUnevenVaultsStart
docs: Start of a Flash swap uneven vaults.
This needs to be the first instruction of the transaction or preceded only by a
ComputeBudget.
This ix has to be paired with a `flash_swap_uneven_vaults_end` (`FlashSwapUnevenVaultsEnd`)
as the last instruction of the transaction. No other instruction targeted the program is
allowed.
The instructions between the start and end instructions are expected to perform the swap.

display.label: Vault Gives Token A for Token B

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.swapper} takes ${data.amount} out of the vaults of strategy ${accounts.strategy} to swap it, to be repaid in the same transaction

instructions.name: flashSwapUnevenVaultsEnd
docs: End of Flash swap uneven vaults.
See [`flash_swap_uneven_vaults_start`] for details.
Warning: This instruction is allowed to be used independently from
`FlashSwapUnevenVaultsStart` and shall not perform any operation
that can be exploited when used alone.

instructions.name: getKtokenPrice
docs: Compute the USD price of a kToken (vault share) for Scope CPI.
Returns the price via `set_return_data`. Handler errors, including account-owner
mismatches, are logged and wrapped in the return data. A malformed required DEX position
propagates as an instruction error.
Returns `None` while a frozen strategy has no live DEX position. This is an unavailable
price and must not be interpreted as a zero price for its outstanding shares.
Caller handling: `Err` = CPI failed, `Ok(None)` = no usable price (not zero),
`Ok(Some(price))` = usable price.
